crossRefs.keyword: robbers of thy people. Heb. children of robbers. exalt

crossRefs.note: For God has put in their hearts to do what he has in mind, to be of one mind, and to give their kingdom to the beast…
crossRefs.keyword: robbers of thy people. Heb. children of robbers. exalt

translations.web: “In those times many will stand up against the king of the south. Also the children of the violent among your people will lift themselves up to establish the vision; but they will fall.
translations.bsb: In those times many will rise up against the king of the South. Violent ones among your own people will exalt themselves in fulfillment of the vision, but they will fail.
translations.kjv: And in those times there shall many stand up against the king of the south: also the robbers of thy people shall exalt themselves to establish the vision; but they shall fall.
translations.asv: And in those times there shall many stand up against the king of the south: also the children of the violent among thy people shall lift themselves up to establish the vision; but they shall fall.
